caseNameFull: John P. Schmitt, etc. v. John Shadrach, Trustee, etc.
summary: Error to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit.
attorneys: Mr. Rush Trescott for plaintiffs in error. Mr. Edwin B. Morgan and Mr. W. A. Valentine for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 4 of Act of January 28, 1915, c. 22, 38 Stat. 803, 804.
